name: tundra
place: A cold steppe-tundra at dawn: flat grass with patches of snow, a frozen stream winding in from the left, a low rocky hill on the right with one big grey boulder, mountains far behind, a pale pink sky.

hunter.look: A Stone Age hunter as people picture early humans: a stocky man in rough fur hides tied with leather cords, bare arms, feet wrapped in hide, holding a long wooden spear with a flint point.
hunter.face: He has a wide flat face, a heavy brow ridge with thick dark eyebrows, small deep-set brown eyes, a broad flat nose, a strong square jaw with a short tangled beard and long matted black hair.

girl.look: A young Stone Age woman hunter as people picture early humans: a fur cape over a hide dress, a necklace of animal teeth, holding a flint knife.
girl.face: She has a long oval face, high cheekbones, narrow amber eyes, straight thin eyebrows, a small upturned nose, a pointed chin and long red hair in two rough braids.

shots.desc: A cold steppe-tundra at dawn: flat grass with patches of snow, a frozen stream winding in from the left, a low rocky hill on the right with one big grey boulder, mountains far behind, a pale pink sky. He has a wide flat face, a heavy brow ridge with thick dark eyebrows, small deep-set brown eyes, a broad flat nose, a strong square jaw with a short tangled beard and long matted black hair.
